ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 40% high-intensity white and 60% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The left lobe features dense, irregular black mottling and focal spots on a white background. The right lobe is predominantly black with white mottling localized at the distal tip and scattered spots along the inferior edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency, varying amplitude serrations; prominent jagged peaks and deep indentations are visible along the margin of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep along the lateral margins terminating in distinct, pointed tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial clusters of small circular dark spots on the white base of the left lobe and small white circular spots at the distal end of the black right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced raggedness and irregular pixel loss at both distal lobe tips; the left tip displays a localized patch of yellowish-brown discoloration compared to the surrounding pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Extreme asymmetrical pigmentation pattern between the left and right lobes.
